title: Gilbert Arizona Scavenger Hunt Adventure
includes: One scavenger hunt interactive walking activity for your entire group.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must have smartphone with cellular data service.
IMPORTANT: Registration Instructions will be found on the Voucher & Email after completing purchase
Must be able to walk around 2 miles.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Set out on an unforgettable adventure in Gilbert! Explore the town’s farming beginnings and its rise into a vibrant suburban hub. Crack clever riddles, uncover the fiery history of Liberty Market, and be amazed by the strength behind a 10-ton granite sphere. Discover how the town’s original jail found new life as a pump house and decode the meaning behind a historic military boxcar number. Snap fun selfies, enjoy a few fishy fun facts, and wrap up the journey with tales from a traveling gnome—Gilbert’s hidden stories are waiting!
